notes.title: Live on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[p]We are so thrilled to announce Fallen Fates is now [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hibernian-workshop/fallen-fates" style="button" buttoncolor="#568656"]live on Kickstarter[/url][/p][p][/p][p]The big day is here 🥰[/p][p]We put all our heart in this campaign and we hope you’ll feel it too!![/p][p][/p][p]We tried to put as many details about the game as we could and we took much pleasure to do so![/p][p][/p][h2]New Trailer[/h2][p]For the occasion we prepared a 2 minutes long trailer including traditional cinematics made by[b] Sapin Sympa collective[/b]. It will also feature a lot of new in-game content to depict better what the game aims to look like.[/p][previewyoutube="SzmrRiz65cc;full"][/previewyoutube][p]And…this trailer is voiced! We didn’t announce it much yet but[b] Ben Starr[/b] will be voicing Arven!!![/p][p]We’re thrilled to have him on board and his voice gives so much depth and life to Arven, we love it! 😄
[/p][h2]Six One Indie showcase[/h2][p]In addition to the Kickstarter trailer, we’ll be live at Six One Indie showcase with another trailer! [/p][p]Showcase will be aired at 6PM CEST: [/p][h2][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QncfsZr_fxQ"][/dynamiclink]Early Birds[/h2][p]We said in our previous [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hibernian-workshop/fallen-fates/posts/4487241"][u]newsletter[/u][/url] that your support was important, and early backers have a huge impact on a Kickstarter success too.[/p][p]That’s why you’ll find 3 Early Birds tiers:[/p][list][*][p]2 of them are a discount on a digital tiers and a physical tiers[/p][/*][*][p]The 3rd one is a premium tiers in which you’ll also have [b]a figure of Ayla’s from Astral Ascent for the same price.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We have planned many amazing digital and physical rewards![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637285/9d5acb62992029ed6765a0516d13a140d0464681.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being around from the start of this exciting new journey and we hope you will love this game we are crafting as much as we do!

- The Hibernian Workshop Team[/p]
